title: Hearthstone of the Death Squad
paragraphs: A crime series built around Inspector Hearthstone, a recurring detective character who emerged from Mystery Theatre and investigates murder cases with a Scotland Yard-style procedural flavor.
CBS sustaining detective series centered on Inspector Hearthstone, successor/extension of the Hummerts Mystery Theatre lineage.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: CBS Hearthstone run (August 30, 1951 to 1952) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Alfred Shirley (performer), Anne Hummert (producer), Henry Howard (director), Frank Hummert (writer (performer), Harry Cramer (announcer), producer) (performer), and Art Hannes (announcer).

The stories often return to police investigation and homicide squad, murder-case procedural, Hummert mystery-radio production lineage, missing heiress and identity concealment, marriage annulment and domestic motive, and narcotics and organized crime.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Hearthstone of the Death Squad CBS run, Hummert Mystery Theatre lineage, and Fragmentary surviving Hearthstone corpus.
